task_bin.label: Task binary
task_bin.description: Path or name of the `task` executable on PATH.

taskrc_path.label: Taskrc path
taskrc_path.description: Alternate rc file (empty = ~/.taskrc or $TASKRC). Passed as rc:<path>.

data_location.label: Data location
data_location.description: Default data dir offered during auto-init (empty = ~/.task).

poll_seconds.label: Refresh interval
poll_seconds.description: How often the background service re-exports tasks.

badge_mode.label: Badge count
badge_mode.description: Which count the bar widget badge shows.

show_completed.label: Include completed in list
show_completed.description: Default status filter also matches completed tasks.

show_count.label: Show count
show_count.description: Show the task count badge. Off = icon-only button.

show_refresh.label: Show refresh button
show_refresh.description: Inline refresh button in the widget.

use_overdue_glyph.label: Swap glyph when overdue
use_overdue_glyph.description: Use the overdue glyph while anything is overdue.

overdue_glyph.label: Overdue glyph
overdue_glyph.description: Glyph shown while anything is overdue.

show_overdue.label: Overdue pill
show_overdue.description: Extra overdue count pill. Shown only while overdue is above zero.

show_active.label: Active pill
show_active.description: Extra pill with the started-task count.

show_today.label: Due-today pill
show_today.description: Extra pill with the due-today count.

show_next_task.label: Next task text
show_next_task.description: Inline highest-urgency task description, truncated to fit the bar.

highlight_overdue.label: Highlight overdue
highlight_overdue.description: Tint the badge red while anything is overdue.

hide_when_empty.label: Hide when empty
hide_when_empty.description: Hide the whole widget while the count is zero.

project_filter.label: Track project
project_filter.description: Count only this project (empty = all). Unknown names fall back to all.

click_tab.label: Click opens
click_tab.description: Which tab a left click opens.

right_click_tab.label: Right click opens
right_click_tab.description: Which tab a right click opens.

show_next_in_tooltip.label: Tooltip shows next task
show_next_in_tooltip.description: Include the highest-urgency task in the tooltip.

tasks.empty_hint: No tasks match. Adjust filters or add one.

add.date_hint: Natural dates work: today, tomorrow, eow, 2026-12-01.

edit.empty_hint: Pick a task from the Tasks tab (pencil button), then edit it here.
edit.title: Edit · {id}
edit.confirm_delete_hint: Tap Delete again within 8s to confirm

projects.track_pinned: This project is pinned in widget settings - change it there to untrack.
projects.empty_hint: Assign a project when adding a task and it shows up here.

tags.hint: Tap a tag to filter Tasks. Tap again to clear.
tags.empty_hint: Add +tag words when creating a task and they show up here.

stats.undo_tooltip: Undo last change (any source, incl. CLI/sync)

setup.title: Taskwarrior setup
setup.stuck_hint: 3. Still stuck? Create the config by hand, or point Taskrc path at an existing file in plugin settings.
setup.error_hint: This doesn't look like a missing database, so auto-setup is disabled to protect your config. Fix it in a terminal, or point Taskrc path at another file in plugin settings.

status.note_skipped_missing: Task added, note skipped (task not found)
status.sync_none: Sync isn't configured — data is local, nothing to do
status.sync_none_body: No sync replica configured. See task-sync(5) to set one up.
status.decode_error: task export is not valid JSON
